title: Best Plugin Developers (2026): How to Hire One
description: How to hire a plugin developer for WordPress, Shopify apps or other platforms: what to include, how to brief it, price factors and red flags.
intro: A plugin adds a feature to an existing platform, such as WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify, Figma or a browser. Custom plugins make sense when no existing plugin does what you need, or when existing ones are too heavy. Plugin projects go wrong when the plugin breaks with platform updates, conflicts with other plugins, or cannot be maintained after the developer leaves. This guide helps you commission a plugin that lasts.

faq.q: Should I buy an existing plugin or build a custom one?
faq.a: Check existing options first. A well-maintained plugin is often cheaper and safer. Custom plugins make sense for specific needs or when existing ones are bloated or poorly supported.

faq.q: Will the plugin break when the platform updates?
faq.a: It can. Ask the developer to follow the platform's official guidelines and to explain how updates will be handled after delivery.

faq.q: Can I sell the plugin later?
faq.a: If you own the rights. Agree in writing that you receive full rights to the code written for you.
Ask for testing on a copy of your site with your theme and other plugins active, since conflicts are common.
